[[File:Count_Dooku.png|thumb|250px|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and Count of Serenno]]
{{Quote|The Counts of Serenno do not complain and cry. We are born to take care of others. We don't expect others to take care of us.|Count Dooku|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A '''count''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] title, of which the typically feminine equivalent was [[Countess/Legends|countess]].

The title was used by the noble families of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at least during the period of the [[Alderaan Civil War]] circa [[3643 BBY]]. [[Alde (Count)|Count Alde]] of [[House Alde]] was one such bearer of the title.

[[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] was ruled by several [[Count of Serenno/Legends|counts]]. The most famous was [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who reclaimed his ancestral title when he left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
